name: Telem
description: Telem web search and page fetch tools for OpenClaw.

apiKey.label: Telem API Key
apiKey.help: Telem API key (fallback: TELEM_API_KEY env var).

baseUrl.label: Telem Server URL
baseUrl.help: Telem deployment to call (fallback: TELEM_BASE_URL). Defaults to the hosted service.

fields.label: Telem Search Fields
fields.help: Explicit V2 result fields (fallback: TELEM_FIELDS, comma-separated). Mutually exclusive with tier.

providersInclude.label: Included Telem Providers
providersInclude.help: Replace the deployment provider set (fallback: TELEM_PROVIDERS_INCLUDE, comma-separated).

providersExclude.label: Excluded Telem Providers
providersExclude.help: Remove providers from the selected set (fallback: TELEM_PROVIDERS_EXCLUDE, comma-separated).

fullContent.label: Retrieve Full Content
fullContent.help: Ask providers to retrieve full page content (fallback: TELEM_FULL_CONTENT=1). Search never renders it inline; use telem_fetch for page reads.
